# WebAssembly grammars

These MIT-licensed parsers come from the official grammar packages on npm. Each package's license is included here. Repotruck bundles the parsers for offline use and verifies downloaded copies against the SHA-256 values in the grammar manifest.

| Files | Upstream package |
| --- | --- |
| TypeScript and TSX | `tree-sitter-typescript@0.23.2` |
| JavaScript | `tree-sitter-javascript@0.25.0` |
| Python | `tree-sitter-python@0.25.0` |
| Go | `tree-sitter-go@0.25.0` |
| Rust | `tree-sitter-rust@0.24.0` |
